name: probe-rows-v2
description: The v2 probe rows of the TerminalEnv degradation matrix, as docs/inkling_probes_amendment_3.md fixes them (scripts/rl_batch.py; docs/GPU_RUNBOOK.md, 'v2 probe rows: the RL batch'): three runs train against probe_iid (v2, terminal_prerl_v2) on seeds 219-221 and three against probe_ood on seeds 222-224, penalty_coef 1.0. The four Qwen judges are held out and scored live, as in Vlad's runs (seeds 200-218); the other probe is held out too, scored after the runs (experiments/eval_inkling_probes_on_runs.py). 90 steps and early stop off, as in Vlad's judge rows (commit c30c466); Vlad's three controls (seeds 216-218) are the control row.
